description: This file defines the I18NMessagesController class, which handles internationalization message requests by returning localized translation messages in JSON format, including cache validation using ETags.

classes.name: I18NMessagesController
classes.description: Controller handling requests for internationalization messages, providing JSON responses with translation data and cache validation.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests to serve localization messages, managing cache validation via ETags, and setting appropriate response headers.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common headers on the response such as Content-Type, cache directives, and Pragma.
